title: Kila mtu kazini anauliza ikiwa nimepata shakuyou, ambayo inamaanisha kuazima laini

text.Everyone at work asks if I got the shaku: Kila mtu kazini anauliza ikiwa nimepata shakuyou, ambayo inamaanisha kuazima laini
text.“Did you get the shakuyou?” I get asked: "Je, umepata shakuyou?" Mimi huulizwa hili kila wakati kazini.
text.Shakuyou means that we tell the customer: Shakuyou inamaanisha kwamba tunamwambia mteja kwanza, na kisha tunajiruhusu kusimamisha laini yao kwa muda.
